description: McGrail et al. Genetic association and machine learning improve the prediction of type 1 diabetes risk. Nature Genetics, published 30 April 2026. doi:10.1038/s41588-026-02578-y. Licence: CC BY 4.0. A genome-wide association study of type 1 diabetes. Add the genes the study names at each associated locus.

proposal.notes: Lists the T1D risk loci (about 100) with lead variants and stats; the Signal column is named by gene (e.g. PTPRC, RGS1). Supplementary Table 4 covers only novel loci (8 rows), so Table 2 is the per-locus table to add genes to.

rerun: a rerun after the registered result, under the amendments of 4 Nov 2026: development, not a test

proposal.notes: Each row is one GWAS locus named by a gene symbol in Signal; the study names that gene at the locus, so the gene is linked to type 1 diabetes (MONDO:0005147) as a statistical association. The predicate is the general gene-condition association, since the table gives a locus-level GWAS signal rather than a demonstrated causal role. Lead variant, effect size and p-value are carried as edge properties. Genes resolve to Protein nodes as the graph uses proteins for genes.

problems: 4_domain_range: biolink:gene_associated_with_condition's domain is biolink:Gene, which does not admit biolink:Protein

proposal.notes: Each row is one GWAS locus named by a gene symbol in Signal, linked to type 1 diabetes (MONDO:0005147) as a statistical association. The subject is typed GeneOrGeneProduct, the superclass of Protein, so the Pharos protein nodes that gene_symbol returns are admitted. biolink:gene_associated_with_condition was refused because its domain is Gene, which excludes Protein. genetic_association is the general gene-to-trait predicate, fitting a locus-level GWAS signal rather than a causal role. Lead variant, effect size, standard error, p-value, risk allele and credible set size are carried as edge properties.

problems: 2_predicate: biolink:genetic_association is abstract, a mixin or deprecated
3_categories: subject category biolink:GeneOrGeneProduct is not a concrete class below biolink:NamedThing
4_domain_range: biolink:genetic_association's domain is biolink:NamedThing, which does not admit biolink:GeneOrGeneProduct
8_identifiers: subject: 95 of 95 distinct identifiers are under prefixes ['UniProtKB'] that biolink:GeneOrGeneProduct's id_prefixes do not list

proposal.notes: Each row is a GWAS signal named by its gene (Signal column), which the study names at the associated locus. Gene-to-type 1 diabetes is mapped as a genetic association; the locus-level evidence (lead variant, beta, p-value) is carried as edge properties. Gene symbols such as SEPT2 may be outdated aliases; unresolved ones are dropped by the resolver.
